channel.title: Blow Your Mind
channel.desc: Dr Chris and Dr Xand bring you the top space experts on the planet to show you things that will truly Blow Your Mind! In this episode they find out all about the angle of the Earth's spin and how it affects lots of things, including our four seasons. Their friend and physicist Professor Brian Cox explains what the wild weather is like on other planets and what makes Earth the best place to live. And they discover how a massive space impact a long time ago made the Earth go wonky.
